note: Display models known to publish more than one EDID identity, one group per physical panel. The app uses this only to preselect the likely target when the user is offered a merge in settings; it never declares an equivalence on the user's behalf, and it never widens what may be switched. Curated by hand — see scripts/identity-oracle.mjs for how candidates are proposed.

groups.evidence: product-facts.md: the same panel publishes MSI:3CF0 at 3840x2160 and MSI:7CF0 at 1920x1080. Confirmed on real hardware, and macOS's own display records report the same two values.
